description: Highlight elements on the preview-pane page, lastingly (drive_preview's own marks fade; annotations stay until removed) — point at findings, flag what you're about to change, keep your place. Use the refs from drive_preview action='elements'. add: outline one element (optional short label — a word or two, drawn on the page). hold: freeze the whole visible field, every element outlined and named. remove/clear: take one/all down. Marks follow their element on scroll; navigation clears them.
name: annotate_preview
